title: CaliaCorp 3: Facility Tour
description:
You’ve arrived at a CaliaCorp facility. A special one. You’re here to investigate the mysterious Project Succu8u5. What is it? And what’s really going on behind the scenes at CaliaCorp, a 250 year old business that’s seemingly conquered the world.

In this leap into the future, you’ll see what the world is like for CaliaCorp in a distant horizon. Your android assistant will guide you through the facility, showcase the work going on and give you a little history of the company. Just… don’t mind the background hum. It’s just our data centre. The noises in the machine are just the beeps and boops of code firing back and forth. You’re not being brainwashed to forget what you came for.

And don’t forget to complete the survey on the way out. Oh and… perhaps you’d like to take a job here? Really give yourself to CaliaCorp…

Part one of CaliaCorp 3: Future Imperfect.

Art by Mejroong.
author: Mistress Calia
